callaway-elyte: Liked as long and forgiving, often winning fittings; a few report cracked crowns or failed heads.
callaway-elyte-mini: Loved for straight, forgiving play with many more fairways; a few report crown cracks.
callaway-elyte-triple-diamond: Praised for lower spin, more distance and tighter dispersion; a few find it fade biased.
callaway-quantum-mini: Loved as forgiving and straighter off the tee with little distance lost; one misses a big driver.
callaway-quantum-triple-diamond: Praised for lower spin and more distance; a couple say it is not enough of a step up for the money.
callaway-quantum-triple-diamond-max: Praised as longer and lower spinning while staying forgiving; a few found it hard feeling or loud.
cobra-ds-adapt-max-k: Loved as very forgiving, keeping mishits and slices in play; some note a draw bias.
cobra-ds-adapt-x: Liked as long and more forgiving than expected; evidence on downsides is thin.
ping-g430-max: Loved as forgiving, easy to hit and straight; some find too much spin or high launch.
ping-g430-max-10k: Praised as extremely forgiving with far more fairways; a fair number report cracked crowns.
ping-g440-k: Liked as forgiving and straight with slices tamed; good hits can be a bit shorter for some.
ping-g440-max: Praised as very forgiving and straight with a feel many like; some find it not the longest.
taylormade-qi35-ls: Liked for distance, low spin and tight dispersion; several report faces popping within weeks.
taylormade-qi35-max: Liked as long and forgiving, with fitting results that beat others; several report early cracks.
taylormade-qi4d: Loved as long, straight and forgiving, often beating rivals at fittings; a minority could not hit it.
taylormade-qi4d-ls: Praised for distance and low spin with faster ball speed; a couple find it harder to hit solidly.
taylormade-r7-quad-mini: Loved as a much straighter driver replacement; many give up roughly 10 to 15 yards.
titleist-gt2: Praised for more distance, straighter shots and forgiveness; cracked crowns are the top complaint.
titleist-gt280-mini: Loved as a much straighter driver or 3-wood swap; many say it costs some distance.
titleist-gt3: Loved as long, low spinning and great feeling; some find it less forgiving than the GT2.
titleist-gts2: Liked as very forgiving, with more fairways and little lost on off-centre hits; few real complaints.
